title: Detention Dominatrix (ORIGINAL)
description: Welcome class. My name is Headmistress Shibby. I might be standing in for today Mrs Barneby, but I am your superior afterall and I won’t tolerate any back chatter or disobedience in my classroom. You will speak only when asked or instructed. This is an advanced school afterall, strictly for adults seeking to continue their education, so it’s all above board. With that introduction out the way, a little bit of housekeeping before we begin our Science and Biology lesson. I have it on good authority that your next class after this one is Sex Education with Miss Chatsworth. She set you a crucial piece of homework to complete and bring with you today. You must all bring a semen sample in a glass to your next class. I trust that you’ve all completed this assignment for her… If you haven’t already, before we begin properly, I want you to go grab one of the glasses, excuse yourself to the bathroom and return here once you’ve filled it with your sample then sit it in front of you on the table within arms reach. I might even spare you detention if you fill it to the brim. In the meantime, class will take a brief recess while we all wait on you. Go on then, chop chop! Today we’re going to be learning about Apex Predators and the Natural Environment. I want you to focus your attention on the big clock above my head. Can you hear it? Tick… tock… tick… tock… The key to hunting in the wild is absolute patience… The key to surviving as prey is total attention to detail…
author: Mistress Shibby
